short_description:
GTA 6 tattoo shop locations: there are 11 tattoo studios. The first one you can reach is The Inked Mermaid in Key Lento (the only one in Mariana County). Eight more are in Vice-Dale County and two in Kelly County; on the map they show as an orange heart icon (or use the map's Style filter). Electric Fang Tattoo in Stockyard is for Ultimate Edition owners only. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #7 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Dexerto, TechWiser, TheClick, GAMES.GG, Libertycity.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
